players.bio: Aaron Bouwman (born 28 August 2007) is a Dutch professional football player who plays as a centre-back for Eerste Divisie club Jong Ajax. Career Bouwman is a product of the youth academies of RKVV DSS, Koninklijke HFC and Ajax. He made his professional debut with Jong Ajax in a 1–1 Eerste Divisie tie with Roda on 26 April 2024.

Abdellah Ouazane (Arabic: عبد الله وزان; born 15 January 2009) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club AFC Ajax and its reserve squad Jong Ajax. Born in the Netherlands, he represents Morocco at youth international level.
Anton Gaaei (born 19 November 2002) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Eredivisie club Ajax.

Caio Henrique Oliveira Silva (born 31 July 1997), known as Caio Henrique, is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Ligue 1 side Monaco, either as a left-back or a midfielder. Club career Born in Santos, São Paulo, Caio joined Santos' youth setup in 2008, aged ten. On 1 February 2016, he was sold to Atlético Madrid, as his contract was due to expire.
Charlie Terence Setford (born 11 May 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Milton Keynes Dons on loan from Dutch club Ajax.

Daley Blind (Dutch pronunciation: ; born 9 March 1990) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for La Liga club Girona. He has been deployed in a variety of defensive roles – as a defensive midfielder, left back and centre back. He is the son of former Ajax defender and former Netherlands national team manager Danny Blind.
Davy Klaassen (born 21 February 1993) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Ajax, which he captains, and the Netherlands national team.

Dies Janse (born 17 January 2006) is a Dutch professional footballer for Eredivisie club Groningen on loan from Ajax. Early life Janse was born in Goes in Zeeland, where he played there for VV Kloetinge and JVOZ prior to joining Sparta Rotterdam in 2018. He joined the academy of Ajax in 2020.
Don-Angelo Christoffel Annum-Assamoah Konadu (born 3 May 2006) is a Dutch footballer who plays as forward for Ajax.

Edwin van der Sar (born 29 October 1970) is a Dutch football executive and former player. Widely regarded as one of the greatest goalkeepers of all time, he was most recently the chief executive of Eredivisie club Ajax.
Joeri Jesse Heerkens (born 8 May 2006) is a footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ajax. Born in the Czech Republic, he is a Netherlands and Czech Republic youth international.
Jofre Torrents Salvat (born 28 January 2007) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eredivisie club Ajax.

Johan Jordi Cruijff (anglicised to Cruyff; born 9 February 1974) is a Dutch-Spanish professional football director, coach and former player. Following an appointment in December 2025, he is the Technical Director at Ajax. He is the son of footballer Johan Cruyff. He played from 1992 through to 2010, including periods with Barcelona and Manchester United.
Jorthy Mokio (born 29 February 2008) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Eredivisie club Ajax.

Julian Brandt (born 2 May 1996) is a German professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ajax and the German national team. Brandt made over 55 combined appearances for Germany's youth teams, playing at every level from U15 to U21. He was a member of the squad that won the UEFA European Under-19 Championship in 2014.

Kasper Dolberg Rasmussen (Dborn 6 October 1997) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club Ajax and the Denmark national team. Dolberg made his senior debut at Silkeborg IF in May 2015. He joined Ajax in July 2015 and made his debut for the club in July 2016.

Kō Itakura (born 27 January 1997) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as centre-back or defensive midfielder for Eredivisie club Ajax and the Japan national team. Club career In January 2019, Itakura joined Premier League club Manchester City and was immediately loaned to Eredivisie club Groningen, until the summer of 2020.

Lucas Oliveira Rosa (born 3 April 2000) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Dutch club Ajax. Mainly a right-back, he has been deployed as a right wing-back and a left-back on occasion. Internationally, Lucas played for his native Brazil at under-17 level.
Maarten Paes is a professional goalkeeper who currently plays for AFC Ajax in the Dutch Eredivisie and represents the Indonesia national team.
Maher Mauricio Carrizo (born 19 February 2006) is an Argentine footballer currently playing as a centre-forward for Vélez Sarsfield and for the Argentina national under-20 football team.

Marc-André ter Stegen (German pronunciation: ⓘ; born 30 April 1992) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Ajax, on loan from La Liga club Barcelona, and the Germany national team. He is known for his reflexes, passing, and ball-playing.
Marcos Leonardo Santos Almeida (born 2 May 2003), known as Marcos Leonardo (Brazilian Portuguese: ), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Saudi Pro League club Al-Hilal.

Miguel Ángel Sánchez Muñoz, known as Míchel (born 30 October 1975), is a Spanish professional football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He is the head coach of Eredivisie club Ajax.

Oleksandr Volodymyrovych Zinchenko (born 15 December 1996) is a Ukrainian professional footballer who plays as a left-back or midfielder for Eredivisie club Ajax and the Ukraine national team. Zinchenko began his career at Russian Premier League team Ufa before joining Manchester City in 2016 for a fee around £1.7 million.
Oliver Valaker Edvardsen (born 19 March 1999) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club Ajax.
Oscar Gloukh (born 1 April 2004) is an Israeli professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Eredivisie club Ajax and the Israel national team.
Owen Wijndal (born 28 November 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eredivisie club Ajax and the Netherlands national team.

Rayane Bounida is a 19-year-old Belgian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Ajax in the Dutch Eredivisie. He also features for their reserve team, Jong Ajax, in the Eerste Divisie.

Sofyan Amrabat (born 21 August 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Real Betis, on loan from Süper Lig side Fenerbahçe, and the Morocco national team.

Steven Berghuis (born 19 December 1991) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ajax and the Netherlands national team. He made his debut for the Netherlands in 2016, and represented the national team at UEFA Euro 2020.

Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare, commonly referred to as Tolu, is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Nigeria national team. Career During his youth in Nigeria, Arokodare played for Kash Academy and Flying Sports Academy in Festac, as well as the Segun Odegbami International College and Sports Academy.
Youri Baas (born 17 March 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie club Ajax.
Youri Pieter Regeer (born 18 August 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back or midfielder for Eredivisie club Ajax.
